description: This file defines a JavaScript module providing API wrapper functions for a frontend web application. It includes methods for making HTTP requests (GET, POST, DELETE, PATCH) to a backend API, handling authorization headers, error responses, and specific endpoints such as work items and comments management. The module also includes internal helpers for request construction and error handling, as well as functions to generate URLs and manage authentication data from localStorage.

methods.name: isPublicPath(path)
methods.description: Determines if a given API path is public (no authorization required), such as login or signup endpoints.

methods.name: buildHeaders(path, extra = {})
methods.description: Constructs request headers, including Authorization if the path is protected.

methods.name: handleErrorResponse(resp, data, path)
methods.description: Handles non-OK HTTP responses, throws errors, and manages auto-logout on 401 responses for protected routes.

methods.name: apiDelete(path)
methods.description: Sends a DELETE request to the backend, returns parsed JSON, and handles errors.

methods.name: apiPost(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a POST request with JSON body, returns parsed JSON, and handles errors.

methods.name: apiGet(path, params)
methods.description: Sends a GET request with optional query parameters, returns parsed JSON, and handles errors.

methods.name: apiPatch(path, body)
methods.description: Sends a PATCH request with JSON body, returns parsed JSON, and handles errors.

methods.name: getWorkItemComments({ project_id, id })
methods.description: Fetches comments for a specific work item identified by project_id and id.

methods.name: addWorkItemComment({ project_id, id, body, author_id = null, author_display_name = null })
methods.description: Adds a new comment to a work item, sourcing author ID from localStorage if not provided.

methods.name: getWorkItems({ projectId } = {})
methods.description: Retrieves work items, optionally filtered by project ID.

methods.name: createWorkItem({ project_id, item_type, title, description, status, priority, created_at })
methods.description: Creates a new work item, automatically uses current user's displayName from localStorage as creator.

methods.name: updateWorkItemStatus({ project_id, id, status })
methods.description: Updates the status of a specific work item.

methods.name: buildUrl(path)
methods.description: Builds a full URL for an API endpoint based on current base URL.
